title: Same-day replay rollback: a late reconcile drops today's already-applied hit and restores a saver today's miss consumed
tier_reason: local streak/saver state rolls back; callers that fall back to the model streak (no contest observation) can pass the wrong streak to selection

contract.text: With consistent local history and no admissible outcome or slot changes, reconciliation preserves every terminal result already applied through the locked replay instant, including today's streak increment and saver consumption; it excludes unplayed previews and future dates.

mechanism.text: reconcile_results replays streak state from history but excludes today's file, so a 23:00 run after today's terminal hit saves the pre-today streak and can restore saver_available=True after today's saver-consuming miss

residual.text: Unfixed; contest-backed decisions do not use the local replay streak, but callers allowing model-state fallback (e.g. preview without a contest observation) can be affected.

watchdog.trigger: after any reconcile run, the local streak/saver differs from the value implied by applying every terminal slot result through now (including today's)
watchdog.recovery_assertion: two consecutive late reconciles leave streak, saver and pick files unchanged

evidence.what: a daytime or late-night reconcile rolls local streak state back before today's already-scored result; pre-existing in HEAD
two 23:00 reconciles leave (1, True) instead of (2, True) and (10, True) instead of (10, False) (strict XFAIL, 2/2 accepted); the undelivered-preview control passes
every install in the continuous logged chain 7/02 -> 9/22 (last: 4490aee) carries the unchanged grading/reconcile code; no fix exists

notes: a firing would show as a local streak drop after a late reconcile; Route R can compare streak.json history with reconcile runs
